Chapter 774: Chapter 3 Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter (Subscribe Request)_3

And now, the inner world inside him was still not Lin Yuan’s limit; the Fusion of Time and Space Rules were merely at the First Realm. Once it reached the Fifth Realm, the inner world would become even more perfect and complete.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit sat cross-legged.

In front of him lay item after item of exotic treasures, those being the Twelve-Star Strange Treasures weapons.

“These exotic treasure weapons that are of no use to me could be broken down back into Primal Force to nourish the Origin Clock or simply serve as nourishment for my cultivation of the Xuanhuang Physique.”

...

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Supreme weapons were indeed powerful, but not every one of them was suitable for Lin Yuan.

If one were to discuss compatibility, no weapon could compare to the Origin Clock.

This weapon, made of Origin Fine Gold, had always been nurtured by Lin Yuan and naturally was a perfect fit for him.

The only drawback was that, compared with the supreme weapons, the Origin Clock was slightly lesser in rank, but the impact was not significant.

Lin Yuan had mastered Primal Force and could revert all things back into the most fundamental pure power; eventually, he would continue to slowly nurture the Origin Clock, aiming to cultivate it into a supreme weapon.

Of course, such a task could only be hoped for when Lin Yuan reached Tier 11. How extraordinary were the Twelve-Star Strange Treasures? They couldn’t just be reverted on a whim.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

After continuing to observe the changes in his inner world,

Lin Yuan once again took out the Enlightenment Light Sphere of Rules and immersed himself in cultivation.

Besides normally understanding rules, Lin Yuan was also slowly perfecting the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

“The core of the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter lies in the physical body, in the soul, in the Spirit Will—returning to essence and roots. Only with a strong foundation does greater potential emerge.”

Lin Yuan continually observed one by one the physical souls of those special beings deep in the Cosmic Starry Skies.

Normally speaking, special beings were rare, and some unique special beings existed only once in the vast universe. Their mystical physical bodies, the essence of their souls, their innate abilities—even a Supreme Being could not peer into these aspects.

Yet, thanks to four spheres of light given to him by the half-meter-tall old man, Lin Yuan could distinctly feel everything about many special beings, immensely propelling the perfection of the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

It is known that each unique special being is a darling of the universe, graced with everything close to the Great Dao.

Lin Yuan’s use of these special beings’ physical souls to perfect the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter was truly a path with an extremely high limit lifting him to the heavens.

It was not a path that led to a dead end or dead alley.

It was like standing at the height of the universe and creating and developing an Evolution Path.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan and Nalan comfortably sat together.

Beyond his practices, Lin Yuan would also enter the Virtual World to relax, albeit just with a sliver of consciousness, not hindering his normal practice of Enlightenment.

“This time the Two-dimensional World has fallen, and those Different Species Strong Ones suffered, especially the Four Divine Kings, even losing the most suitable supreme weapons for themselves in there.”

Nalan had a somewhat schadenfreude attitude, although his avatar also experienced a fundamental loss by dying in the Two-dimensional World, he was compensated to some degree by Human Civilization afterward.

Lin Yuan returned eleven exotic items to the Supreme Beings, parts of which compensated various human Evolvers.

After all, many human Evolvers also contributed in the search for these exotic items, and naturally, Human Civilization would not let them be at a loss.

“Indeed, quite tragic.”

Lin Yuan nodded, originally the Four Divine Kings were among the first tier of strong ones below the Supreme Beings. But now, they had lost a weapon perfectly suited to them.

Whether it was the Star Alliance, or the human civilization, or the Insect Race Alliance, all had collected a number of supreme weapons.

But for life forms below the level of Supreme Beings, finding a suitable supreme weapon was nothing short of climbing to the heavens.

Having lost that supreme weapon, even if the Four Divine Kings received another supreme weapon bestowed by the Star Alliance, they could not return to the peak of their combat power.

Moreover, the death of an avatar in the Two-dimensional World meant a permanent loss of some of the Spirit Will.

This also had a significant impact on their strength.

The two factors combined.

Although the Four Divine Kings weren’t reduced to mediocrity, they could no longer compare to beings like the ‘Mother of the Tree Realm.’

Even their time for challenging the Ultimate would be indefinitely postponed, but no matter how much it was delayed, the possibility of finally becoming Ultimate had decreased.

Apart from the Four Divine Kings, many other special beings and Different Species’ Strong Ones also suffered great losses, at least losing part of their Spirit Will fundamentally.

Spirit Will, unlike physical body, cannot be improved with the help of Rare Treasures.

To increase the strength of Spirit Will, one does not know how much effort is needed; having lost a part permanently, the stronger the being, the heavier the loss.

“Hehe, how about those Different Species’ Strong Ones? Unique special beings, how are they, still beaten up by our human Lord Xueyu?”

“In the competition in the Two-dimensional World, only Lord Xueyu emerged as the ultimate victor.”

A smile appeared on Nalan’s face.

Although, at present, Human Civilization hasn’t publicly announced that Lord Xueyu had successfully exited from the Two-dimensional World,

even the human civilization’s Evolvers have guessed that Lord Xueyu must have survived.

The Different Species’ Strong Ones also have such speculations, but can only speculate.

As a Peak Clan with nine Supreme Beings standing guard, other Different Species, despite their great losses, dare not do anything against Human Civilization.

…

Time slowly passed.

In a blink, two and a half years had gone by.

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan quietly sat there.

“What is a physical body? What is a soul?”

Thoughts surged in Lin Yuan’s mind.

The mystique of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses’ bodies, their innate abilities, etc., all converged in Lin Yuan’s heart, forming the foundation of the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

One does not know how much time had passed.

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes, a smile appearing on his face: “Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter… completed.”
